Server producer: wz_buoy_stash.gsc registers the same field without callback (gsc 33) and plays buoy scenes via struct::get_array("buoy_stash","targetname") + scene::play("p8_fxanim_wz_floating_buoy_bundle") (gsc 49-57). function_c621758a gate (gsc 59-91): level.var_f45d4bf5 = getgametypesetting(#"hash_3778ec3bd924f17c") && getgametypesetting(#"hash_1f840366731cc3e") default 0; when false, requests item_world::function_4de3ca98 and, for a defined dock_yard_stash_2 result, calls item_world::function_160294c7, then returns without buoy-field writes. The latter helper2531-2592 waits, validates fields, conditionally requests item consumption and finally requests setdynentstate(stash,3); state3 meaning and any actual concealment are unproved; when true, sets scene.scene_ents[#"prop 1"] clientfield::set("buoy_light_fx_changed", 2) if distance2d(stash.origin,scene.origin) < 200 (coordinate units unproved) and synchronously calls function_5a6d95 (85; no thread), whose wait1 polling can block later scene iterations until return; only opaque function_ffdbe8c2(stash)==2 leads to the field1 request at110; this is not a proved dynent-state getter or numeric-state meaning. A defined stash with distance2d>=200 requests field1 at89; a missing stash skips both writes at78. Target source requests (29-45): calls stopfx on a defined prior self.fx_id before the switch; newval1/2 replaces it via util::playfxontag on tag "tag_light_buoy03_jnt".
